# PDF 2MB — Smart PDF Optimizer

> Web service for automatic PDF compression to <= 2000 KB (2 MB) with maximum text sharpness, color stamps/signatures preservation, and intact OCR text layer.

## Key Capabilities
- **Target size enforcement**: Strictly <= 2000 KB (default 1995 KB) or user-defined target (100 KB – 25 MB).
- **Automatic strategy selection**:
  - Vector / text-only PDFs: lossless stream optimization, font subsetting, image recompression.
  - Contrast scans / documents with color stamps: MRC 300 DPI (CCITT Group 4 1-bit text mask + compressed color layer).
  - Faint toner / photo-heavy scans: RGB 4:4:4 JPEG / JPEG 2000 with adaptive DPI and quality binary search.
- **OCR Preservation**: Retains invisible searchable OCR text layer when rasterizing or applying MRC.
- **Batch Queue & ZIP Export**: Upload multiple PDFs at once, track real-time progress via Server-Sent Events (SSE), download individual files or a combined ZIP archive.
- **Privacy**: Temporary files are stored only for processing and automatically deleted after TTL expiration (default 1 hour).

## URLs & Endpoints
- Web App: https://pdf2mb.chifty.top/
- Health / Readiness: `/healthz`, `/readyz`
- Queue Status: `GET /api/status`
- Upload & Compress: `POST /api/jobs` (multipart `files`, optional `target_kb`)
- Live Progress (SSE): `GET /api/jobs/{job_id}/events`
- Download Result: `GET /api/download/{job_id}`
- Batch ZIP: `POST /api/download-zip`
